title: Generic local music + girlfriend corner image on Valentine screens

requirements.summary: Remove Weeknd-specific song labeling and avoid hardcoding the audio source to an “earned-it” file while keeping local-only playback controls with clear missing-audio guidance.
acceptanceCriteria: The music section does not display the text “Earned It — The Weeknd” anywhere in the UI.
The app does not hardcode the audio source to /assets/audio/earned-it.mp3 (or any Weeknd-specific filename).
Music controls (play/pause and mute/volume slider) remain available and continue to work with local static audio files.
If the audio file is missing, the UI still shows a clear, English error/help message indicating the user must add a local audio file.

file_operations.description: Update the Valentine page music section to (1) use a generic local static audio filename (not an “earned-it”/Weeknd-specific path), (2) change the UI title/copy to generic wording (e.g., “Background music”), and (3) display a clear help message telling the user to add a local audio file when missing, while preserving the existing play/pause and mute/volume UI behavior.
Refine the missing-audio error/help messaging (English, user-actionable) to align with the generic local static audio setup, without introducing any external/streaming sources.

requirements.summary: Add a small decorative girlfriend corner image shown consistently on both initial and success views as a static frontend asset with polished styling and non-obstructive placement.
acceptanceCriteria: A small girlfriend photo is visible in a page corner (consistent placement) on both the initial and success views.
The corner image does not cover the proposal text, buttons, or (remaining) music controls on common mobile and desktop viewport sizes.
The image is served as a static asset from the frontend (no backend fetching).
The corner image has simple, polished styling (e.g., rounded shape and subtle border/shadow) consistent with the existing romantic theme.

file_operations.description: Add the generated corner avatar-style crop asset at frontend/public/assets/generated/girlfriend-corner.dim_256x256.png (from “WhatsApp Image 2026-02-11 at 19.46.32.jpeg”) for static serving.

Render the new static corner image frontend/public/assets/generated/girlfriend-corner.dim_256x256.png in a consistent corner position on both the initial and success views with small size, rounded/circle styling, and subtle border/shadow; ensure layout/z-index and spacing prevent overlap with existing music controls, proposal text, and buttons across common mobile/desktop sizes.
